**Description**
Add new test case to verify PFCWD storm detection on multiple ports at same time

<!--
Briefly describe the problem you are having in a few paragraphs.
-->

**Steps to reproduce the issue:**
1. Send continuous PFC frames to a port/priority to cause it to trigger PFCWD storm
2. Send continuous PFC frames to another port/priority to cause it to trigger PFCWD storm 
3.

**Describe the results you received:**
2nd port wasn't seeing PFCWD storm event.

**Describe the results you expected:**
2nd port should have received PFCWD storm.

comments.author: lipxu
comments.body: Hi, @neethajohn , seems this case is for triggering of PFCWD behavior on multiple ports sequentially, Is there any difference in behavior between triggering PFCWD on multiple ports simultaneously?

comments.author: neethajohn
comments.body:
> Hi, @neethajohn , seems this case is for triggering of PFCWD behavior on multiple ports sequentially, Is there any difference in behavior between triggering PFCWD on multiple ports simultaneously?

Yes, there was some issues seen in some platforms when wd was triggered sequentially but could not see any issues when wd was triggered simulataneously on multiple ports, hence this testcase
